title: Revit Configuration Asset Source Resolution
purpose: Record whether exact Revit implementation registries and presets referenced by Appendix E and the workflow catalogue exist as concrete Confluence assets, source scaffolds, or future gaps.

assets.notes: Workset rules and inventory captures exist, and the workflow catalogue refers to a Workset Registry, but targeted semantic search plus exact-title CQL found no standalone registry page.

The source inventory contains a datum-workset topic and S6 defines datum-workset purpose. The Instruction Page Agent uses a datum-workset instruction only as a page-naming example; targeted search found no concrete standalone instruction page.
W6.1 references a Sheet Registry and the parent/titleblock instruction defines sheet rules, but exact-title and semantic searches found no concrete registry.
View-template rules and generic examples exist. Exact template names remain TODO/example-level; no standalone registry or controlled exact template catalogue was found.

assets.asset: Object Styles and Line Weights registry
assets.notes: Graphics guidance exists. A similarly named Revit definition appears as an Instruction Page Agent example, not as an identified source page. Exact-title CQL returned no matching concrete page.
Template governance explicitly calls for a concrete catalogue/registry but marks its filename and implementation as TODO/future.
Lifecycle gates are described, but the concrete workflow artifact is explicitly TODO.
Validation categories are described, but the concrete ruleset artifact is explicitly TODO.
Machine-readable instructions exist for configuration selection, geometry conversion, shared-coordinate positioning, property export, execution and evidence.
The concrete Navisworks instruction set refers to an Export Preset Registry as future. No generic PDF/IFC preset registry was found.
Documentation/export source contains naming and partial settings, but the standard settings section is incomplete and no standalone preset artifact was found.
IFC version/MVD and exact defaults remain TODO/client-dependent; no standalone preset artifact was found.
Substantive QA guidance exists, but the workflow catalogue marks the registry as future and no concrete registry page was found.
Health-check functions are described, but the workflow catalogue explicitly marks the Model Health Report as future.

supplementary_sources.notes: Secondary Revit view/workflow guidance reinforces purpose-driven View Templates, filter governance, logged exceptions, and QA but does not provide authoritative exact registry values.
Specifies how an agent should consolidate Revit L6 source material; it is not itself the consolidated instruction corpus.

search_method.semantic: Targeted Rovo/Confluence searches for registries, presets, exact instruction IDs, model-health and QA assets.
search_method.exact_title: CQL title searches for datum/workset management, sheet registry, view templates, export preset, model health, object styles, line weights, PDF export, IFC export and QA/QC checklist returned no matching standalone pages.

migration_rule: Absence of a concrete source asset must remain a gap; do not manufacture the referenced registry, preset, or instruction during extraction.

provenance.migration_note: Direct source-resolution review only; not canonical authority.
